structured_output.summary: The Set constructor follows spec steps 1-8 in order. It throws a TypeError when NewTarget is undefined. It creates the object with create_collection using %Set.prototype% and an empty SetData. It returns early for undefined or null. It then does Get(set, "add"), checks IsCallable, and calls GetIterator (sync). The loop uses iterator_step_value and calls adder. If the adder call fails, it closes the iterator with the error and returns that error, which is IfAbruptCloseIterator. The worker wrapped steps 7-8 in a local AddValuesFromIterable helper, which the current spec inlines. The behaviour is identical. The remaining test262 failures come from the not-implemented Set.prototype.add, WeakSet and Function, which are outside this ticket. I did not run the build or the tests myself; the gate report says build and clippy are clean and there are no regressions.
